svg.title: Party deployment configurations II
svg.desc: Deployment patterns with extra spatial conditions: Trail, shared short edge, central Safe Zone, and short edges across a Ravine.

Zones, the Trail, the Chasm and the Ravine are drawn to scale on a 36"×36" battlefield (3.3 pt per inch); Hero markers are enlarged.
Zone-depth dimensions show the stated limits. In panels B and C no Hero is placed within the stated distance of an opposing Hero: the
ring (B, 6", from a Party A Hero’s edge; C, 3") marks that distance, and the dimension line between the nearest opposing Heroes runs
between their closest edges (2.6), 7" in B and 4" in C, both outside the limit. Panel B is measured between drawn marker edges; panel
C markers are drawn at their true 1" size. Where the source gives a range (Trail 3–4", Ravine 6–8"), a value inside the range is drawn
